description: Staging password protection: `enabled` turns the password page on or off, `password` (4-64 characters) changes it. Turning it off makes a copy of the live site public (still marked not to be indexed). Returns the current password.

domain.description: Domain of the Cloud for WordPress site, e.g. `example.com`.

dry_run.description: Validate and preview without changing anything.

name: set_wordpress_staging_password
title: Set Wordpress Staging Password
